dataset: UCB-J PET and T1W Images for Synapse Project Cohort
public_access: No login, authorization token, data access application or credential used. Public release only.

validation.release_pin: Git tag 1.0.0 resolved to commit; metadata blob SHA1 verified
validation.images: Every downloaded T1 compressed file SHA256 and byte size matched the content-addressed annex pointer in pinned commit
validation.format: Full gzip decompression CRC plus NIfTI-1 magic/dimensions/voxel size/datatype/payload checks; all voxels finite
validation.clinical: 20 unique participant IDs matched one T1 image each; source labels preserved

limitations: Only one AD participant and five MCI participants; pilot or technical validation only, insufficient for robust stand-alone training or AD performance estimates.
SYNAPSE/Wisconsin ADRC/WRAP origins; check participant overlap before treating as independent of WRAP/NACC.
No label harmonization, preprocessing, training, model evaluation, or external validation claims performed.
Only T1 images, paired JSON and five documentation/metadata files acquired; PET and derivatives excluded.
